reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Dance claims come from the band's own marketing; no crowd video watched.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Phone is the number the band's own site gives for bookings ('Call / Text us'). Booking URL is the site home page, which has the contact form. No logo recorded: the site's flame logo image carries faint 'Adobe Stock' watermarks (it is a stock-image preview), so it was skipped. Gallery photos showing identifiable audience members or member close-ups were skipped. No Instagram or YouTube found (the site embeds a video but links no channel). Facebook URL is the same as current (trailing slash added). Current description still fits.
